# Library

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(tibble)
```

# Load data 

```{r}
# Paramètres
annee_debut <- 1927
annee_fin <- 2024

# Systèmes de coordonnées de référence 
standard_crs <- 4326
mdg_crs <- 29702 


categories <- c("I", "II", "III", "IV", "V", "VI", "Not defined")
 
palette_couleur <- c(
  "I"           = "#F8766D",
  "II"          = "#C49A00",
  "III"         = "#53B400",
  "IV"          = "#00C094",
  "V"           = "#00B6EB",
  "VI"          = "#A58AFF",
  "Not defined" = "#F564E3"
)

# Regroupement strict/multi-usage 
cat_strict <- c("I", "II", "III", "IV")
cat_multi <- c("V", "VI")

groupes <- c("Strict categories (IUCN I–IV)",
             "Multi-use categories (IUCN V–VI)",
             "Not defined")

# Palette niveaux de gris 
palette_nb <- c(
  "Strict categories (IUCN I–IV)" = "#404040",
  "Multi-use categories (IUCN V–VI)" = "#B0B0B0",
  "Not defined"              = "#FFFFFF"
)

enquetes <- tribble(
  ~annee, ~type,
  1997,   "DHS",
  2008,   "DHS",
  2011,   "MIS",
  2013,   "MIS",
  2016,   "MIS",
  2018,   "MICS",
  2021,   "DHS"
) %>%
  mutate(type = factor(type, levels = c("DHS", "MIS", "MICS")))


dynamic_wdpa <- st_read(
  "data/dynamic_wdpa.gpkg",
  quiet = TRUE
) %>%
  st_transform(standard_crs)

names(dynamic_wdpa)

dynamic_wdpa %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% count(STATUS, sort = TRUE)
dynamic_wdpa %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% count(DESIG_TYPE, sort = TRUE)
dynamic_wdpa %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% count(MARINE, sort = TRUE)
dynamic_wdpa %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% count(IUCN_CAT, sort = TRUE)

# Contour national (adm0) en arrière-plan
contour_mada0 <- geodata::gadm(country = "Madagascar", level = 0,
                               path = "data/raw/gadm") |>
  st_as_sf()


# Préparation des données
pa_sf <- dynamic_wdpa %>%
  filter(st_geometry_type(.) %in% c("POLYGON", "MULTIPOLYGON")) %>%
  mutate(
    annee_creation = as.integer(STATUS_YR),
    cat_iucn = case_when(
      IUCN_CAT %in% c("Ia", "Ib") ~ "I",
      IUCN_CAT %in% c("II", "III", "IV", "V", "VI") ~ as.character(IUCN_CAT),
      TRUE ~ "Not defined"
    ),
    groupe = case_when(
      cat_iucn %in% cat_strict ~ groupes[1],
      cat_iucn %in% cat_multi  ~ groupes[2],
      TRUE                     ~ groupes[3]
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(WDPAID) %>%
  mutate(annee_creation = suppressWarnings(
    min(annee_creation[annee_creation > 0], na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  arrange(desc(valid_from), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

# Statuts restants avant filtre
pa_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% count(STATUS, sort = TRUE)

pa_sf <- pa_sf %>%
  filter(
    STATUS == "Designated",
    DESIG_TYPE == "National",
    !str_detect(DESIG_ENG, regex("Ramsar|World Heritage|Biosphere", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    MARINE %in% c("0", "1"),
    is.finite(annee_creation),
    between(annee_creation, 1900, annee_fin)
  ) %>%
  st_transform(standard_crs) %>%
  st_make_valid()

# Restriction au terrestre
land_mdg <- contour_mada0 %>%
  st_transform(mdg_crs) %>% st_make_valid() %>% st_union()

pa_mdg <- pa_sf %>%
  st_transform(mdg_crs) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_intersection(land_mdg) %>%
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>%
  filter(!st_is_empty(st_geometry(.))) %>%
  st_make_valid()

pa_sf <- st_transform(pa_mdg, standard_crs)

as.numeric(st_area(land_mdg)) / 1e6
sum(as.numeric(st_area(pa_mdg))) / 1e6
pa_mdg %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% count(groupe)
```


```{r}
# Surface cumulée par année 
vide     <- function() st_sfc(st_polygon(), crs = mdg_crs)
aire_km2 <- function(g) as.numeric(sum(st_area(g))) / 1e6


surface_hierarchique <- function(data, colonne, niveaux) {
  annees_chg <- sort(unique(pmax(data$annee_creation, annee_debut)))
  annees_chg <- annees_chg[annees_chg <= annee_fin]

  map_dfr(annees_chg, function(y) {
    d    <- data %>% filter(annee_creation <= y)
    deja <- vide()
    res  <- numeric(length(niveaux))

    for (i in seq_along(niveaux)) {
      di <- d %>% filter(.data[[colonne]] == niveaux[i])
      if (nrow(di) == 0) next
      u      <- st_union(di)
      res[i] <- aire_km2(st_difference(u, deja))
      deja   <- st_union(c(deja, u))
    }
    tibble(annee = y, niveau = niveaux, surface_km2 = res)
  }) %>%
    complete(annee = annee_debut:annee_fin, niveau = niveaux) %>%
    group_by(niveau) %>%
    arrange(annee, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    fill(surface_km2, .direction = "down") %>%
    replace_na(list(surface_km2 = 0)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(niveau = factor(niveau, levels = rev(niveaux)))
}

surface_cat <- surface_hierarchique(pa_mdg, "cat_iucn", categories)
surface_grp <- surface_hierarchique(pa_mdg, "groupe",   groupes)


list(
  total_cat = sum(filter(surface_cat, annee == annee_fin)$surface_km2),
  total_grp = sum(filter(surface_grp, annee == annee_fin)$surface_km2),
  pays_km2  = as.numeric(st_area(land_mdg)) / 1e6
)
```


```{r}
graphique <- function(data, palette, titre_legende, noir_blanc = FALSE,
                      xmin = annee_debut, xmax = annee_fin) {

  theme_base <- if (noir_blanc) theme_bw(base_size = 11) else theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

  ggplot(data, aes(x = annee, y = surface_km2, fill = niveau)) +
    geom_area(
      position  = "stack",
      alpha     = if (noir_blanc) 1 else 0.9,
      color     = if (noir_blanc) "black" else NA,
      linewidth = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      data = enquetes,
      aes(xintercept = annee, linetype = type),
      color = "black", linewidth = 0.5,
      show.legend = c(fill = FALSE, linetype = TRUE)
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette, breaks = names(palette),
                      drop = FALSE, name = titre_legende) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c(DHS = "solid", MIS = "dashed", MICS = "dotted"),
      name   = "Surveys"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      name   = "Year of creation",
      breaks = seq(1930, 2020, by = 10),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name   = expression("Cumulative terrestrial protected area (km"^2*")"),
      labels = label_comma(),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(xmin, xmax)) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(order = 1, nrow = 1),
      linetype = guide_legend(
        order = 2, nrow = 1, keywidth = unit(1.2, "cm"),
        override.aes = list(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6)
      )
    ) +
    theme_base +
    theme(
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      legend.box       = "horizontal",
      legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.key       = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = if (noir_blanc) "black" else "grey20"),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = "black")
    )
}

dir.create("outputs", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

graph_couleur <- graphique(surface_cat, palette_couleur, "IUCN Category")
graph_nb      <- graphique(surface_grp, palette_nb, "Protection level",
                           noir_blanc = TRUE)

graph_couleur
graph_nb

ggsave("outputs/cumulative_protected_area_by_IUCN.png",
       plot = graph_couleur, width = 10, height = 5.5,
       units = "in", dpi = 300, bg = "white")

ggsave("outputs/cumulative_protected_area_black_white.png",
       plot = graph_nb, width = 10, height = 5.5,
       units = "in", dpi = 600, bg = "white")

```
